facts.text: Andrew participated in a rock climbing class on a Sunday and reached the top, describing the experience as a challenge and satisfying.

evidence.quote: Last Sunday was awesome - my friends and I took a rock climbing class and I made it to the top! It was a fantastic experience and now I'm hooked.
Rock climbing was awesome! It was a challenge, but so satisfying.

facts.text: Andrew shared a photo of the view from the top of the rock climb, which Audrey found stunning and described as an accomplishment.

evidence.quote: Wow that view is stunning! Congrats on reaching the top, that must have been a huge accomplishment.
The view was stunning, and I was really proud of myself.

facts.text: Andrew mentioned that the rock climbing class was challenging, especially as a beginner, but he succeeded with the support of his friends.

evidence.quote: It was a big achievement for me. The climb was tricky, especially since I'm still a newbie. But I made it with the support and cheer from my friends.
